Good day shift leads,
The kennel attendant asked me to write about feeding routines

For the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways, I am logging the current guidance so the handoff stays clean. Please keep food service aligned with the welfare coordinator's notes and use the same wording when you brief the ground team. If a passenger sounds unsure, answer in plain language and keep the focus on comfort, cleanliness, and calm handling. <<FACT F068>> After that, confirm the crate tag is clear and the carrier stays with the booking file.

For animals moving through the desk, the main point is consistency. We should avoid loose advice and instead give short, useful directions that match the pet's plan. If Priya Moretti or Mei Costa calls with concerns, listen first, then repeat the approved steps without adding extra detail. <<FACT F066>> When Maggie or any other pet is mentioned, note any feeding change, then pass it to the next shift so no one is guessing. The ground team should keep carriers level, watch for signs of stress, and report anything unusual right away.

Please treat this as a standing reminder for the desk file and the next handoff. Clear notes help the whole route run smoother, and they reduce back-and-forth at the counter. Keep the language brief, kind, and consistent, and send any unresolved comfort issue to the senior coordinator at once.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
